policy: External sources may be used only when rights are clear. Competitor question text, answer choices, explanations, images, videos, transcripts, and paid course material must not be copied or closely paraphrased.

sources.title: adamisntdead/theory-test-questions
rights_evidence: GitHub repository has no detected licence for the data.
Repository README says the data was scraped from theory-tester.com and the questions are not the repository author's own material.
Package metadata marks code as MIT, but that does not grant commercial reuse rights to the question bank.
sources.notes: Do not import this dataset unless the question owner grants a commercial reuse licence covering the data.

sources.title: Competitor Irish theory-test practice websites
blocked_uses: clone page structure or paid content
sources.notes: Use competitor sites to understand product positioning only. Do not use them as content sources.

sources.title: Irish driving instructor YouTube videos
blocked_uses: use creator content in ads without permission
sources.notes: If a creator agrees to provide source notes, record the permission before using them.

sources.title: Reddit and learner forum discussions
sources.notes: Forum anecdotes are not evidence of official exam frequency.

sources.title: RSA Rules of the Road
sources.notes: Use for factual verification and original explanations, not as copied content.

sources.title: Official Driver Theory Test revision material
sources.notes: Do not ingest paid official content unless a commercial licence explicitly permits it.

estimated_high_yield_topic_signals.reason: Image/sign recognition is visually distinctive and easy to drill repeatedly.
estimated_high_yield_topic_signals.allowed_action: Use our existing licensed/owner-approved sign assets and original explanations only.

estimated_high_yield_topic_signals.topic: Right of way, junctions, roundabouts, and merging
estimated_high_yield_topic_signals.reason: Learners commonly need scenario practice and safety-first judgement.
estimated_high_yield_topic_signals.allowed_action: Create original scenario drafts from approved source notes.

estimated_high_yield_topic_signals.topic: Speed, stopping distance, weather, and road conditions
estimated_high_yield_topic_signals.reason: Safety-critical judgement topics fit high-yield review.
estimated_high_yield_topic_signals.allowed_action: Cross-check rules and write original coaching explanations.

estimated_high_yield_topic_signals.topic: Alcohol, drugs, penalties, insurance, NCT, and licence rules
estimated_high_yield_topic_signals.reason: Legal consequence topics are important and should be kept current.
estimated_high_yield_topic_signals.allowed_action: Verify against current official/legal sources before publishing.

estimated_high_yield_topic_signals.topic: Vehicle control, tyres, brakes, lights, and maintenance
estimated_high_yield_topic_signals.reason: Technical items are practical and often benefit from clear memory tips.
estimated_high_yield_topic_signals.allowed_action: Use original wording and admin review.

estimated_high_yield_topic_signals.topic: Vulnerable road users, cyclists, pedestrians, buses, and emergency vehicles
estimated_high_yield_topic_signals.reason: Safety-critical behaviour and observation topics should be prioritised.
estimated_high_yield_topic_signals.allowed_action: Create original practice from approved notes.

next_actions: Contact any source owner before importing their question bank.
Use competitor sites, YouTube, Reddit, and forums only for non-verbatim research signals.
Write admin-approved source notes in original words.
Generate original draft questions from approved notes only.
Review drafts before publication and keep provenance attached.
